rows.jyutping: zoeng1 jan4 nam2 dak1 hou2 seoi1
rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose colloquial way to say someone assumes the worst about other people's motives.

example.english: He's really cynical and always thinks people have ulterior motives when they help.
example.traditional: 佢真係將人諗得好衰，成日覺得人哋幫手都有目的。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zan1 hai6 zoeng1 jan4 nam2 dak1 hou2 seoi1 seng4 jat6 gok3 dak1 jan4 dei6 bong1 sau2 dou1 jau5 muk6 dik1

rows.traditional: 覺得 N 做乜都係為自己
rows.jyutping: gok3 dak1 N zou6 mat1 dou1 hai6 wai6 zi6 gei2
rows.note: Use this construction for the worldview that people act mainly or only out of self-interest.

example.english: I’m cynical and think people do everything for themselves.
example.traditional: 我覺得人哋做乜都係為自己。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gok3 dak1 jan4 dei6 zou6 mat1 dou1 hai6 wai6 zi6 gei2

rows.note: Choose this when cynical emphasizes a bitter, contemptuous, or mocking way of speaking rather than distrust alone.

example.english: They're cynical and always make cruel jokes about other people's troubles.
example.traditional: 佢講嘢一向尖酸刻薄，成日拎人哋嘅傷心事嚟笑。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gong2 je5 jat1 hoeng3 zim1 syun1 hak1 bok6 seng4 jat6 ling1 jan4 dei6 ge3 soeng1 sam1 si6 lai4 siu3
